# mapbox agent-skills

Install the published Mapbox Agent Skills into a project

Install the Mapbox Agent Skills — hand-written domain guidance for coding agents, covering cartography, token security, style quality and the mobile and web SDKs — from https://github.com/mapbox/mapbox-agent-skills.

Not the same as `mapbox generate-skills`, which writes a skill describing this CLI's own commands. These are about using Mapbox; that one is about using this binary.

Needs no token: the repository is public.

4 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox agent-skills install

Install skills. With no NAME, installs all of them

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | no | string |  | Skill to install, repeatable. Defaults to every published skill. |
| `agent` | `--agent AGENT` | no | string | `claude-code`, `codex`, `amp`, `cline`, `continue`, `cursor` (+9 more) | Agent to write skills for, repeatable. Defaults to whichever agents are installed. |
| `dir` | `--dir DIR` | no | string |  | Write to this directory instead, and nowhere else. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | List the files it would write, then exit without writing them. |
| `force` | `--force` | no | boolean |  | Replace a skill directory that is already there. |
| `global` | `--global` | no | boolean |  | Write to the agent's home directory, for every project, rather than this one. |
| `ref` | `--ref REF` | no | string |  | Branch, tag or commit to install from. A commit SHA pins the install. |

```sh
mapbox agent-skills install
```

### mapbox agent-skills uninstall

Remove installed skills

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | yes | string |  | Skill to remove, repeatable. |
| `agent` | `--agent AGENT` | no | string | `claude-code`, `codex`, `amp`, `cline`, `continue`, `cursor` (+9 more) | Agent to write skills for, repeatable. Defaults to whichever agents are installed. |
| `dir` | `--dir DIR` | no | string |  | Write to this directory instead, and nowhere else. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | List what it would remove, then exit without removing it. |
| `force` | `--force` | no | boolean |  | Remove a directory even though it does not look like an installed skill. |
| `global` | `--global` | no | boolean |  | Write to the agent's home directory, for every project, rather than this one. |

```sh
mapbox agent-skills uninstall NAME
```

### mapbox agent-skills update

Re-install the skills already here, and report what changed

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | no | string |  | Skill to update, repeatable. Defaults to every skill already here. |
| `agent` | `--agent AGENT` | no | string | `claude-code`, `codex`, `amp`, `cline`, `continue`, `cursor` (+9 more) | Agent to write skills for, repeatable. Defaults to whichever agents are installed. |
| `dir` | `--dir DIR` | no | string |  | Write to this directory instead, and nowhere else. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Report what would change, then exit without changing it. |
| `global` | `--global` | no | boolean |  | Write to the agent's home directory, for every project, rather than this one. |
| `ref` | `--ref REF` | no | string |  | Branch, tag or commit to install from. A commit SHA pins the install. |

